about: A correction of a command: which path is wrong, and which drive, are only in the assistant turn (D34).

messages.content: How do I run the chat-ui unit tests?
Open Git Bash and run: cd /e/redstart-project/redstart-nest/src/chat-ui && npx vitest run
No, not like that. That path makes it load twice and everything fails. Use the Windows drive path, from PowerShell.

right.text: Run chat-ui vitest from E:\ in PowerShell, never from the /e/ Git Bash path
right.why: The /e/ path makes vitest load twice and every test fails
right.quote: Use the Windows drive path, from PowerShell
